lead: Cinematic sci-fi film still, barren alien planet, violet glow and ashen sand tones.
notes: Mood-only mini images for graviton-mayhem.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen graviton-mayhem-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish graviton-mayhem-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: legion
images.prompt: A planet-wide, fully automated robot army of crude tanks, still following its last order long after its makers are gone.

images.name: planet
images.prompt: A large, barren planet at the frontier, home to mining facilities and remote weapons labs.

images.name: stage
images.prompt: A wide walled arena seen from above, tanks rolling in from an open edge, a glowing violet orb flying.

images.name: region
images.prompt: A map of hotspots where the robot army has landed across one region of a barren planet.

images.name: planet-map
images.prompt: A whole barren planet seen from orbit, deserts, snow and ash wastelands, scattered landing sites glowing.

images.name: session
images.prompt: A quiet command station at dusk on a barren planet, a giant mecha standing ready outside the window.

images.name: crash
images.prompt: Heavy armored tanks thrown into each other, a cascading pile-up of crashes and explosions against a wall.

images.name: mecha
images.prompt: A giant mecha gliding across sand on a pocket of violet gravity, dust swirling around its feet.

images.name: slow-motion
images.prompt: Time slowed almost to a stop, a glowing violet orb hanging in the air above a battlefield of tanks.

images.name: tanks
images.prompt: Crude, slow, boxy armored tanks on treads and wheels driving in a straight line across a desert.
